articles.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
articles.snippet: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

articles.title: ENS seeks DAO approval to activate upgraded Ethereum naming system
articles.snippet: New .eth registrations would pause for hours during the transition, while existing domain holders could renew their names without migrating.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits $84K resistance as Korean tech rout deepens KOSPI losses
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s liquidity kept BTC price below $84,000 amid a mounting South Korean tech and semiconductor stock sell-off.

articles.title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
articles.snippet: Blur’s planned website closure revived criticism of the royalty policies and token rewards that helped it overtake OpenSea during the NFT boom, but hurt creators.

articles.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
articles.snippet: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.
